First a cast list is drawn up from locally counted candidates, then each character gets a profile: biography, personality, story, relationships and quotes, each pointing to the passage it came from. The number of requests depends on how many characters there are, not on the book\'s length: about %1$d at most, billed by your provider.\n\nFinished profiles are saved right away. If you stop, leave the app or it is closed by the system, you can continue without paying again.
